title: Astra Travel Miles Platinum
text:
**Astra Travel Miles Platinum**

**Product Summary**
* Premium travel card offering accelerated miles, lounge access, and comprehensive travel
* insurance suited for frequent flyers.

**Eligibility**
* Age 21–70
* Minimum monthly income: ₱35,000 OR Average Daily Balance (ADB) ≥ ₱50,000 across CASA
* Good credit standing; no past-due accounts in the last 12 months

**Fees & Charges**
* Annual Fee: ₱4,500 (Primary), ₱2,250 (Supplementary) — waiver rules depend on Hexagon tier +
* ADB (see table)
* Foreign Transaction Service Fee: 2%

**Credit Limit Range**
* ₱80,000 – ₱800,000 (based on income, ADB, and risk profile)

**Age-Based Perks**
```text
Age Band | Core Perks
---------------------
18–24 | 1.0x miles on spend; 1 lounge pass/yr; student/first-job travel kit
25–45 | 1.5x miles on airlines/hotels; 4 lounge passes/yr; travel insurance up to ₱5M
46–59 | 1.25x miles; 2 lounge passes/yr; medical add-on coverage; concierge upgrades
60+ | 1.25x miles; 2 lounge passes/yr; senior priority hotline; trip disruption assistance
```

**Hexagon Tier & ADB Conditions**
```text
Hexagon Tier | ADB (₱) | Conditions / Fee Waiver Rules
------------------------------------------------------
Prestige  | ≥ 150,000 | Annual fee waived; lounge passes +2; min spend requirement removed
Priority  | ≥ 100,000 | Annual fee waived; else 50% off if ADB ≥ 75,000
Privilege | ≥ 75,000  | Annual fee 50% off; upgrade to waiver if annual spend ≥ ₱300,000
Lite      | ≥ 50,000  | Annual fee 25% off; upgrade to 50% off if annual spend ≥ ₱200,000
```

**Notes for Recommendation Logic**
* Best for customers aged 25–45 who show high travel/entertainment spend.
* Use normalized ADB from core_customers and deduplicate CRM by email+dob before scoring.

title: Build+ Student & Starter
text:
**Build+ Student & Starter**

**Product Summary**
* Entry card designed for students and first-jobbers to build credit responsibly, with
* progressive upgrades.

**Eligibility**
* Age 18–35 (age-based rules apply)
* For 18–20: school ID + parent/guardian co-maker unless Hexagon ≥ Priority
* For 21–35: employment certificate OR ADB ≥ ₱15,000

**Fees & Charges**
* Annual Fee: ₱0 – ₱1,200 depending on tier + ADB (see table)
* Late Payment Fee: ₱800 (first waiver available for students)

**Credit Limit Range**
* ₱8,000 – ₱120,000 (starts low; grows with on-time payments and ADB)

**Age-Based Perks**
```text
Age Band | Core Perks
---------------------
18–20 | Tuition/installment support; 2% cashback on campus needs; 1 free missed payment wai
21–29 | 3% cashback on transport/food; 1 bill-payment rebate/mo; credit-limit review after
30–35 | 3% utilities/mobile; upgrade path to Everyday Max if on-time for 12 months
36+   | Not eligible (use Everyday Max or Miles card instead)
```

**Hexagon Tier & ADB Conditions**
```text
Hexagon Tier | ADB (₱) | Conditions / Fee Waiver Rules
------------------------------------------------------
Prestige  | ≥ 60,000 | Annual fee waived; auto-upgrade review after 6 months
Priority  | ≥ 40,000 | Annual fee waived; co-maker not required for 18–20
Privilege | ≥ 25,000 | Annual fee 50% off; starter limit +20%
Lite      | ≥ 15,000 | Annual fee ₱0 for first year; maintain ADB to keep waiver
```

**Notes for Recommendation Logic**
* Great for 18–29 age band; use age from birthdate and ADB from core file to score.
* Auto-upgrade: if on-time payments for 12 months AND ADB ≥ tier threshold, recommend Everyday
* Max.

title: Everyday Max Cashback
text:
**Everyday Max Cashback**

**Product Summary**
* High-value cashback card optimized for groceries, fuel, utilities, and digital subscriptions.

**Eligibility**
* Age 18–75
* Minimum monthly income: ₱20,000 OR ADB ≥ ₱30,000
* No current delinquency; at least 6 months of relationship preferred

**Fees & Charges**
* Annual Fee: ₱2,500 — tiered discounts/waivers via Hexagon + ADB (see table)
* Overlimit Fee: ₱750

**Credit Limit Range**
* ₱30,000 – ₱500,000 (tiered by risk and ADB)

**Age-Based Perks**
```text
Age Band | Core Perks
---------------------
18–24 | Up to 5% cashback on transport/food; 1 streaming rebate/mo (₱150 cap)
25–39 | Up to 6% on supermarkets/fuel; 3% on utilities; quarterly bill rebate (₱300 cap)
40–59 | 6% groceries/health; 3% utilities; family mobile plan rebate
60+   | 7% pharmacies/clinics; 3% groceries; priority dispute assistance
```

**Hexagon Tier & ADB Conditions**
```text
Hexagon Tier | ADB (₱) | Conditions / Fee Waiver Rules
------------------------------------------------------
Prestige  | ≥ 120,000 | Annual fee waived + +1% cashback booster on two chosen categories
Priority  | ≥ 80,000  | Annual fee waived; else 50% off if ADB ≥ 50,000
Privilege | ≥ 50,000  | Annual fee 50% off; base rates apply
Lite      | ≥ 30,000  | Annual fee 25% off; base rates apply
```

**Notes for Recommendation Logic**
* Recommend to customers with high monthly grocery/utility spend or dependents.
* If ADB falls below thresholds, revert to base 2%/1%/0.5% tiering for categories.
